b1-torokkiuzese-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Siege of Buda
b1-torokkiuzese-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks you about the siege of Buda in 1686.
b1-torokkiuzese-01.prompt: Tell the official why the Holy League besieged Buda and when the castle came back into Christian hands.
cues: Say why the Holy League besieged Buda
Say the date when the castle was retaken
b1-torokkiuzese-01.target: A Szent Liga azért vette ostrom alá Budát, hogy kiűzze a törököket. A vár 1686. szeptember 2-án ismét keresztény kézre került.
b1-torokkiuzese-01.english: The Holy League besieged Buda in order to drive out the Turks. The castle returned to Christian hands on 2 September 1686.
b1-torokkiuzese-01.canDo: I can narrate the siege and liberation of Buda Castle on September 2, 1686.

b1-torokkiuzese-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After Buda
b1-torokkiuzese-02.scenario: On a museum visit, the guide asks you what happened after Buda was retaken.
b1-torokkiuzese-02.prompt: Tell the guide where the armies went as soon as Buda was liberated and what the Turks did after Zenta.
cues: Say where the armies went after Buda
Say what the Turks asked for after Zenta
b1-torokkiuzese-02.target: Amint Buda felszabadult, a seregek dél felé mentek. Miután Savoyai Jenő Zentánál legyőzte a törököket, a törökök békét kértek.
b1-torokkiuzese-02.english: As soon as Buda was liberated, the armies went south. After Eugene of Savoy defeated the Turks at Zenta, the Turks asked for peace.
b1-torokkiuzese-02.canDo: I can describe the battles of Nagyharsány (1687) and Zenta (1697).

b1-torokkiuzese-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Price of Liberation
b1-torokkiuzese-03.scenario: A history teacher asks you in class what the wars meant for the villagers.
b1-torokkiuzese-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what the serfs had to do and what many people had to leave.
cues: Say what the serfs had to pay or endure
Say what many people had to leave behind
b1-torokkiuzese-03.target: A jobbágyok kénytelenek voltak fizetni a porciót. Sokan kénytelenek voltak elhagyni az otthonukat.
b1-torokkiuzese-03.english: The serfs were forced to pay the porció. Many people were forced to leave their homes.
b1-torokkiuzese-03.canDo: I can describe the devastation, scorched earth, and depopulation following the wars.

b1-torokkiuzese-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Disappointment in 1687
b1-torokkiuzese-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks why many nobles were unhappy after the Turks left.
b1-torokkiuzese-04.prompt: Tell the official that the nobles were unhappy although the Turks had been driven out, and what the Commission demanded.
cues: Say the nobles were unhappy despite the liberation
Say what the Commission demanded from them
b1-torokkiuzese-04.target: Noha a törököket kiűzték, a nemesek elégedetlenek voltak. Az Újszerzeményi Bizottság fegyverváltságot követelt tőlük.
b1-torokkiuzese-04.english: Although the Turks had been driven out, the nobles were dissatisfied. The Neoacquistica Commission demanded a weapon ransom from them.
b1-torokkiuzese-04.canDo: I can outline imperial absolutism under Leopold I and the Neoacquistica Commission.

b1-torokkiuzese-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Toward 1703
b1-torokkiuzese-05.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks who led the Kuruc movement and why a new uprising seemed likely.
b1-torokkiuzese-05.prompt: Tell the official who stood at the head of the Kuruc in 1703 and say that a new uprising became inevitable.
cues: Say who led the Kuruc in 1703
Say what became inevitable because of Vienna's policy
b1-torokkiuzese-05.target: II. Rákóczi Ferenc 1703-ban a kurucok élére állt. A bécsi udvar politikája miatt sokak szerint egy új felkelés elkerülhetetlenné vált.
b1-torokkiuzese-05.english: Ferenc Rákóczi II stood at the head of the Kuruc in 1703. Because of the Viennese court's policy, many thought a new uprising had become inevitable.
b1-torokkiuzese-05.canDo: I can explain how Kuruc resistance coalesced into a nationwide movement.

b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From Buda to Rákóczi
b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks you to summarise the end of the Ottoman era in a few sentences.
b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official what happened in 1686, 1699 and 1703.
cues: Say what happened to Buda in 1686
Say who stood at the head of the Kuruc in 1703
b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.target: 1686-ban a Szent Liga visszafoglalta Budát. 1699-ben a karlócai békével lezárult a hódoltság korszaka. 1703-ban II. Rákóczi Ferenc a kurucok élére állt.
b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.english: In 1686 the Holy League retook Buda. In 1699 the Peace of Karlowitz closed the era of Ottoman rule. In 1703 Ferenc Rákóczi II stood at the head of the Kuruc.
b1-torokkiuzese-consolidation.canDo: I can narrate the 1686 reconquest of Buda, battles of Nagyharsány and Zenta, and the 1699 Peace of Karlowitz.
